name: shuvo-portfolio
description: Shuvo Kumar Das portfolio monorepo: frontend (Vite + React) and backend (Express + Redis)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix e2e install
